sheets.noticed: Chalkboard, a big blue 'bowling ball' and a small pink 'tennis ball', and a chalk line below. Okay, some drop thing.
Nothing moves. Same two balls sitting there while the voice talks.
A line slides up under the balls with a tiny 'same height' label. Still nothing falling.
'Which lands first?' in chalk at the top. Fine, I'm half curious, I kind of know the answer.
Two whole seconds of silence and a frozen picture. Ten seconds in and nothing has dropped, so I looked away.

remembers: It asked whether a bowling ball or a tennis ball lands first if you drop them together; I never saw them fall, but I think the answer is they land together.
